title: fix(plugin-auth): Register SAML Provider registers a complete form (it answered 400 for every one)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8twJDyDkhCm8SFYtruR9Rb)_

domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Fixes #30352

Clause-②: no — a form the bridge always refused registers; nothing a caller sends today is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → SSO Providers → Register SAML Provider 的服务端桥接，现在把表单里的「IdP Entity ID」（`issuer` 字段）作为 `samlConfig.idpMetadata.entityID` 发给 `@better-auth/sso`。表单字段和必填项都没变。
- 为什么改：在这之前，管理员在 Setup 里填完整的 SAML 表单，每次都被 400 `SAML_REGISTER_FAILED` 拒绝（"idpMetadata.entityID is required when IdP metadata XML is not provided"），Setup 里根本注册不了任何 SAML 提供方。
- 风险与回滚：只在发给供应商的请求里多带一个 IdP 描述字段，值取自管理员已经在填的字段；漏填字段时仍然在桥接层被拒，并点名缺哪个字段。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：① `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts` 的 `samlConfig` 那一段（新增 `idpMetadata`）；② `register-sso-provider.test.ts` 末尾新增的真实路由测试块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/register-sso-provider.test.ts`，应看到 10 个用例全部通过，其中「a complete form registers the provider」返回 200，并存下一行提供方记录。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`runRegisterSamlProviderFromForm`** (the bridge behind `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register-saml`) now sends `samlConfig.idpMetadata: { entityID: issuer }`. The Register SAML Provider form has no IdP metadata XML field, so the bridge always lands in the vendor's manual-configuration arm, and `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12 requires `idpMetadata.entityID` there: its register body schema (`samlIdentityProviderMetadataSchema`, a union of "metadata XML" and "entityID") refused every form at the parse step, and `assertSAMLIdentityProviderAuthority` (run at register and again in `createIdP` at sign-in) refuses the same config at runtime.
- **Where the value comes from.** The form field set is read on the server side, from the `register_saml_provider` action params in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts`: `providerId`, `issuer` (label "IdP Entity ID", help "The IdP's SAML EntityID (issuer)"), `domain`, `entryPoint`, `cert`, optional `identifierFormat`. The IdP entity ID field exists, so this is a server-only change.
- **Unchanged.** The required set, the refusal of an incomplete form (`400 INVALID_REQUEST` naming the missing field, before the vendor is called), the top-level `entryPoint` and `cert` (the vendor reads them when `idpMetadata` names no `singleSignOnService` or `cert`), `spMetadata.entityID` (the SP metadata URL, which keeps the top-level `issuer` from being read as the SP entity ID) and the answer (`providerId`, `acsUrl`, `spMetadataUrl`).

## Why

An administrator who sets up enterprise sign-in from Setup → SSO Providers → Register SAML Provider could not register any SAML provider there: every complete form answered `400 SAML_REGISTER_FAILED`. The only working path was the vendor's raw `/sso/register`, which Setup does not expose (measured by the #30300 dev, report 6652003986).

## Tests

- **New block in `register-sso-provider.test.ts`: "Register SAML Provider through the REAL route".** The plugin's own `registerAuthRoutes` mounts the bridge on a real Hono app. The auth manager's `handleRequest` is a real `betterAuth()` instance with the real `sso()` plugin and a memory adapter, and the vendor sees the real session cookie of a signed-up user. The platform-admin gate is judged on a platform-admin session shape (its refusals are pinned in `admin-sso-bridge-gate.test.ts`).
  - A complete form answers 200 with `acsUrl`, and exactly one provider is stored, whose `samlConfig.idpMetadata` is `{ entityID: 'https://idp.acme.example/entity' }`.
  - A form without the IdP Entity ID answers 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` naming `issuer`, and nothing is stored.
- **Updated:** the existing shape case also asserts `idpMetadata: { entityID }` in the re-dispatched body.
- Every earlier SAML case used a stand-in for `/sso/register`, which is why this was never seen. The OIDC sibling already had a real-vendor case.

## Verification

All at head `815fcdcd` (`main` `870ebce3` merged; nothing newer on `main` at merge time).

- **Ablation.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the one `idpMetadata: { entityID: issuer },` line (anchor 1 → 0, blob `341a85ef` → `967366eb`), then the file's suite: 3 failed / 7 passed. The real-route case fails with exactly the card's answer: `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"SAML_REGISTER_FAILED","message":"[body.samlConfig.idpMetadata] idpMetadata.entityID is required when IdP metadata XML is not provided"}}`. Restored (`git diff HEAD` empty). The test file imports the bridge from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
- **Suites.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: 223 files passed, 3,937 tests passed, 10 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- **Lint.** eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on both changed source files: exit 0. `pnpm lint` (repo-wide): exit 0.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 61 commands: 60 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 61 derived, 60 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and exits 0 once its pinned commit is fetched. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 locally (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: not every workspace package is built in this worktree), NOT MEASURED, left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The vendor's register body schema types the top-level `issuer` as a URL, so an IdP whose EntityID is a URN (`urn:...`) is still refused by `@better-auth/sso` at the parse step. Not changed here; noted for the seat.
- The form has no IdP metadata XML field, so the vendor's metadata-XML arm is not reachable from Setup; the bridge does not invent one.
